label: Norssit
description: Norssi High School Alumni: short biographies of the 10,137 students of the Helsinki Normal Lyceum (1867-1992), published as linked open data by Aalto SeCo. Ontologies: FOAF, schema.org, SKOS, BIOC.
intro: A natural-language interface to **Norssit**, the alumni register of the Helsinki Normal Lyceum (1867–1992), published by [Aalto University's Semantic Computing Research Group](http://www.ldf.fi/dataset/norssit). Ask about the alumni: their births and deaths, families, titles, employers and hobbies.
example_questions: How many persons are in the register?
How many women are in the register?
When was Mika Waltari born and when did he die?
Which organisations employed the most alumni?
What are the most popular hobbies among the alumni?
topics: alumni of the Helsinki Normal Lyceum, their families, titles, employers and hobbies
org: Aalto University, Semantic Computing Research Group (SeCo)
